Nora V: FYI enterprise pilot 'MeridianHealth' flagged a hard stop on week 3. they will likely pause renewal in 28 days unless we unblock data residency + KMS integration.
Ethan L: what specifically failed? is it our KMS handshake or their policy?
Nora V: their security team refused to push keys to our hosted KMS. they want a customer-managed key via KMS proxy; our default onboarding doc glossed over this.
Priya K: thanks. that's a high-touch ask. suggest immediate save plan: 1) offer a 30-day private key proxy trial in their VPC, 2) schedule a 60-min security sync with their infosec + our security eng, 3) provide 4 hours of dedicated SRE onboarding time.
Maya G: +1. also propose we proactively disable telemetry sampling for their workspace during trial to ease compliance concerns.
Ethan L: engineering note: we have a per-customer kms-proxy feature behind flag but it's not exposed in the console. I can enable it for meridian-001 and provision a temporary service-account today. patch: `POST /internal/customers/meridian-001/flags {"kms_proxy":true}`
CS Ops Bot: [action created] #ticket-5042 assigned to Nora V — "MeridianHealth residency/KMS save plan". Due: 2026-05-02
Nora V: scheduled security sync for Wed 2pm PT. invite to include runbook, scope of logging disabled, rollback plan, and the SRE onboarding slot.
Priya K: also, let's add a commercial element: if they commit to 6 months within 45 days, offer 20% credit for the first two months. if they still need to downgrade, ensure exports and read-only access for 120 days.
Maya G: adding a short downgrade path to ticket: - prorated downgrade to Compliance tier - retain export access for 120 days - 60-day re-onboarding credit at 50% for re-activation.
Ethan L: enabling flag now. will post logs and audit id here when done.
CS Ops Bot: [ticket-5042] status updated -> in-progress (Nora V).
Ethan L: flag active, audit_id=aud-77c3. monitoring auth attempts.
Nora V: after the sync I'll capture the 3 quick feedback items for product: 1) need clearer KMS proxy steps in docs, 2) console exposure for per-customer flags, 3) sample infosec packet for security reviews.
Priya K: perfect. Nora, mark account as "at-risk: security blockade" and add renewal check on day 21. I'll prep the commercial note for AMs.
Maya G: putting a short neutral script for CSMs in the ticket so messaging is consistent if they ask about downgrade.
Nora V: will paste post-sync notes here. thanks everyone. :pray:
CS Ops Bot: reminder -> security sync Wed 2pm PT; ticket-5042 assigned to Nora V.
